model_profile_selection.responsibility: Validate a selected default profile against the supplied effective configuration and persist only that default selection.

model_errors.responsibility: Own transport error identities and privately translate only canonical Agent model errors.

health_diagnostics.migration_rule: EXPAND -> migrate both doctor consumers -> prove zero broker consumers -> CONTRACT run_health_check.
health_diagnostics.responsibility: Execute the product/Agent health-diagnostics use case and return a structured report, human rendering, and readiness projection.

inspection_auxiliary.migration_rule: EXPAND -> migrate bookmark list/add/remove and diagnostic export -> prove zero broker consumers for both Agent mechanisms -> CONTRACT only BookmarkStore and DiagnosticExporter.
inspection_auxiliary.responsibility: Workspace-scoped auxiliary inspection operations over retained traces: bookmark management and diagnostic export.

state_migration.migration_rule: EXPAND -> migrate run_state and its error mapping -> prove zero broker consumers for migrate_legacy_state and StateMigrationError -> CONTRACT only those two exports.
state_migration.responsibility: Orchestrate explicit non-destructive migration of supported legacy runtime state into the selected canonical workspace.

workspace_recents.migration_rule: EXPAND -> migrate recents consumers and B35 -> prove the old Interface module is compatibility-only and InstanceLock has zero broker consumers -> CONTRACT only InstanceLock.
workspace_recents.responsibility: Own the bounded best-effort persistent history of recently opened canonical workspaces.

task_context.migration_rule: EXPAND -> migrate task context composition and CLI error mapping -> prove zero broker consumers for all three Agent symbols -> CONTRACT exactly those exports.
task_context.responsibility: Read and materialize persisted task-definition authority for one workspace, task, and optional phase.

legacy_extension_registry.migration_rule: EXPAND -> migrate llm-agent tools -> prove zero ExtensionRegistry broker consumers -> CONTRACT ExtensionRegistry only.
legacy_extension_registry.responsibility: Own the legacy llm-agent tools registry workflow while preserving extensions/registry.json and its separation from the modern catalog.

task_continuity.migration_rule: EXPAND -> migrate task status and resume preflight -> prove zero TaskContinuityService broker consumers -> CONTRACT that export only.
task_continuity.responsibility: Read and project task continuity for one workspace without execution or storage mutation.

code_commands.migration_rule: C7 execute a finite code command, project an Application-owned outcome, and contract nine broker symbols after zero-consumer proof.
code_commands.responsibility: Interpret, gate, execute, and project one explicit CLI code command without exposing Agent request, context, approval, or result contracts.

code_review.migration_rule: Project private Agent review values into owned immutable DTOs at the C7 approval callback; contract exactly ChangePreview and ProposalAssessment after zero-consumer proof.
code_review.responsibility: Present the finite code review without exposing Agent mutation evidence or confirmation policy.

configuration_errors.migration_rule: C6 Application-owned configuration error types and narrow Agent-to-Application translation.
configuration_errors.responsibility: Own the finite configuration error contract used by Application operations and Interface startup/error mapping.

configuration_admin.migration_rule: C5 finite configuration administration use cases; preserve owner semantics and canonical/external guarded-write split.
configuration_admin.responsibility: Expose finite path, validation, initialization, and migration operations over the Agent-owned configuration repository.

first_run_configuration.migration_rule: C5 UI-neutral first-run configuration projections; guided lifecycle remains Interface-owned through C23.
first_run_configuration.responsibility: Project bounded first-run profile choices and chat-entry readiness without exposing repository/config objects.

discovery_configuration.migration_rule: C5 optional, read-only semantic Discovery configuration resolution; never initializes, mutates, or starts the application.
discovery_configuration.responsibility: Resolve the canonical model profile needed by semantic Discovery and return it intact.

workspace_query.migration_rule: CURRENT narrow Application API: workspace_query only; preserve physical paths and expose typed read-only workspace queries.
workspace_query.responsibility: Typed, UI-neutral, read-only workspace query operations for list, read, find, git status, and diff.
